title: A US judge finds TikTok liable for lying about its safety standards and exposing minors to inappropriate content, in a 2025 lawsuit filed by Texas AG Ken Paxton (Christian Terry/Click2Houston.com)
summary: Christian Terry / Click2Houston.com: A US judge finds TikTok liable for lying about its safety standards and exposing minors to inappropriate content, in a 2025 lawsuit filed by Texas AG Ken Paxton — State will now proceed to trial to determine relief and penalties — AUSTIN, Texas - A U.S. District Judge has found TikTok liable …
contentText:
Christian Terry / Click2Houston.com :

A US judge finds TikTok liable for lying about its safety standards and exposing minors to inappropriate content, in a 2025 lawsuit filed by Texas AG Ken Paxton   —  State will now proceed to trial to determine relief and penalties  —  AUSTIN, Texas - A U.S. District Judge has found TikTok liable …
